subject: words
title: Bossy r: ir and ur
about: Two more bossy-r spellings that say er: ir as in bird and ur as in fur. CKLA Unit 4 teaches only er, ar and or (ir and ur come in Grade 2), so open this right after the Bossy r level; the last three words have two syllables (NC RF.1.4.b and RF.1.4.e).
tip: Point out that ir, ur and er all say the same er sound; the word just chooses a different vowel to put in front of the r.
